verdict.rationale: Raygun documents first-party, token-authenticated APIs that suit CI pipelines. These include a Deployments API, uploading dSYMs, ProGuard mapping files and JavaScript source maps via API, and real-time deployment tracking. An official MCP server also exists for agent-driven access. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a CLI, a CI integration such as a GitHub Action, or a headless workflow guide. Missing for 10: an explicit CI/headless usage guide or official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
